name: Investigate a suspicious message
short_description: Inspect sender, destination, request, and independent corroboration without activating links or attachments.
self_assessment: I can investigate one suspicious message with four checks without help or opening its links.
description: Inspect sender, destination, request, and independent corroboration without activating links or attachments. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Verify a payment request through an independent channel
safety_note: Malicious content can steal data or install software; avoid links and attachments, verify through a separate channel, and report confirmed abuse.
